auth.login_lead: Sign in to your clinic — doctors, nurses, reception and managers all use the same sign-in.
auth.staff_hint_text: Use the e-mail and password your clinic gave you. You can also sign in from your clinic's own page by choosing your role (doctor, nurse, reception…) first.
auth.signup_lead: Your owner account and your clinic in one step — then a short guided setup of doctors, services and staff logins.
auth.full_name_help: The clinic owner or manager who will administer {brand}.
auth.password_help: At least 8 characters. Longer is stronger.
auth.terms_agree: I agree to the terms of service and privacy policy.
auth.forgot_lead: Enter your account e-mail and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgot_sent_text: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way. It's valid for 60 minutes.
auth.forgot_no_email: E-mail isn't configured on this server, so reset links can't be delivered. Ask your clinic manager to generate a password-reset link for you from Staff & permissions.
auth.reset_lead: Your other signed-in devices will be signed out.
auth.reset_done: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password.
auth.reset_mail_body: A password reset was requested for your {brand} account. The link is valid for {minutes} minutes. If it wasn't you, ignore this e-mail.
auth.newpw_lead: Welcome, {name}. Your clinic created this account with a temporary password — choose a personal password to continue.
auth.newpw_done: Your password is set. Welcome to {brand}.
auth.invite_lead: You've been invited to join {business} on {brand}.
auth.invite_invalid: This invitation has expired, was revoked or was already used. Ask your clinic manager for a new one.
auth.invite_have_account: You already have a {brand} account with this e-mail. Sign in, and you'll come back here to accept the invitation.
auth.side_title: Your whole clinic, in one calm place.
auth.side_text: Appointments, the waiting room, patient records, billing and payroll — in Arabic or English, with the right access for every member of the team.
auth.side_point_1: Online booking on your own clinic page
auth.side_point_2: Separate logins for doctors, nurses and reception

verify.title: Confirm your e-mail
verify.banner: Confirm your e-mail address ({email}) to keep your account secure.
verify.resent: We sent a new link to {email}.
verify.invalid_text: This link has expired or was already used. Sign in and send a new one.
verify.mail_body: Hi {name}, please confirm your e-mail address. This link is valid for {hours} hours.
